content.value_statement: Teams need consistent ASP.NET Core patterns for APIs, data access, authentication, and background work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical .NET backend implementation.
actual_capabilities: Designs ASP.NET Core 8+ APIs using controller-based or Minimal API patterns.
Applies EF Core data access patterns, including DbContext setup and read query optimization.
Guides JWT authentication, policy authorization, and ASP.NET Core Identity integration.
Structures background workers with scoped services and cancellation-aware loops.
Recommends testing, validation, logging, health checks, and API documentation practices.
limitations: Focuses on modern ASP.NET Core 8+ projects, not legacy .NET Framework applications.
Does not provide frontend implementation guidance.
Cloud deployment details require additional provider-specific context.
Sample code still needs project-specific validation and security review.

use_cases.title: Create a Backend API
use_cases.description: Build REST endpoints with validation, DTOs, EF Core persistence, and OpenAPI support.

use_cases.title: Add Secure Authentication
use_cases.description: Implement JWT tokens, identity flows, authorization policies, and secure password handling.

use_cases.title: Improve Service Reliability
use_cases.description: Refactor background jobs, logging, health checks, and data access for production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Minimal API
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a new ASP.NET Core service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a Minimal API for a user management service. Include endpoints, DTOs, validation, EF Core setup, and OpenAPI notes.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Controller
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing Web API controller.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review this ASP.NET Core controller. Improve async usage, validation, DTO mapping, logging, and EF Core query patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Add Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add JWT authentication and policy-based authorization to this backend. Include configuration, token generation, and endpoint protection guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to assess this .NET backend for production readiness. Cover background services, health checks, logging, migrations, caching, and test coverage.

output_examples.input: Design an ASP.NET Core API for creating and listing users.
output_examples.output: A structured API plan with endpoints, request and response models, validation rules, EF Core persistence, and testing notes.

output_examples.input: Add JWT authentication to an existing backend service.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step implementation outline for token settings, claims, signing keys, middleware registration, and protected endpoints.
A reliability-focused review covering scoped dependencies, cancellation tokens, retry handling, logging, batching, and database updates.

best_practices: Provide your target .NET version, database provider, and hosting environment before requesting architecture guidance.
Ask for DTOs, validation, tests, and error handling together when designing API endpoints.
Review generated authentication and data access code against your security and compliance requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not paste production secrets or real signing keys into prompts.
Do not request database changes without describing migration, rollback, and deployment constraints.
Do not treat sample code as production ready without tests, logging, and threat review.

faq.question: What type of projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports modern ASP.NET Core 8+ backend services, including Web API, Minimal API, EF Core, authentication, and background services.

faq.question: Can it help with Entity Framework Core?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide DbContext setup, migrations, query shaping, eager loading, and read-only query optimization.

faq.question: Does it generate complete deployable applications?
faq.answer: It provides implementation guidance and code patterns, but final integration depends on your project structure and deployment environment.

faq.question: Can it help secure API endpoints?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers JWT authentication, ASP.NET Core Identity, claims, roles, and policy-based authorization.

faq.question: Does it cover frontend development?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on backend APIs, data access, services, validation, testing, and operational patterns.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
